extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures digitised: Figures 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7. Figure 2 is XPS characterization and Figure 1 is XRD, so they were skipped. CO formation-rate/TOF values are plotted in Figures 3, 5 and 6, but the target schema has no dedicated CO-rate field; those values are therefore captured in the notes of the corresponding methanol-rate records. Figure 4 selectivity plots report only CH3OH selectivity; CO selectivity was entered as the complement because the paper describes methanol and CO as the carbon products and defines selectivity on product molar flows. Values are approximate readings from the plotted markers.
